title: who is in my simulation distance?
description: tells you who is in your simulation distance!
body:
this mod adds a Notification for when a player or entity is in your simulation distance! and highly customizable with mod menu! 

![player nearby](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3c4271921d2075ba960992dd6e1d3272f8931fd6.png)

**⚠️THIS IS CHEATING ON MOST SERVERS ONLY USE ON YOUR SERVER OR A SERVER YOU HAVE PERMISSION ON⚠️**
